newsitem.title: USA: ADM to build plant to make maltodextrins.
newsitem.headline: ADM to build plant to make maltodextrins.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Monday it will enter the maltodextrin food additive business, and will begin construction immediately of a new state-of-the-art production facility at its Cedar Rapids, Iowa, corn processing plant.
Initial production will begin in early 1998, ADM said.
ADM did not say how much it will invest in the plant or why it decided to begin making maltodextrins.
ADM already produces a range of food additives, including citric acid and high fructose corn syrup.
ADM said it will produce a full range of maltodextrins for food manufacturers.
Maltodextrins are used in conjunction with nutritive and high-intensity sweeteners as bulking agents, flavor carriers, fat replacers and as a source of complex carbohydrates.
